title: Two Seconds
alt: Four panels. 1: Pip, glowing and happy, tells Margo that a rust folder means urgent; Margo, behind her desk with a mug, says rust is paperwork with a deadline. 2: Close-up of the case form, Case 4802: Request, bus to wait. Duration, 2 seconds. 3: A rainy night street at 8:14 PM, elsewhere; a commuter with an umbrella runs toward a mustard bus that is about to leave. 4: Margo stands at her desk with the stamp resting unused beside the form and says 'One.' while Pip watches; CHUNK.
hover: Two seconds is a long time when you are the one who has to give it.
transcript: Panel 1 – PIP: It's rust. Rust is urgent.
Panel 1 – MARGO: Rust is paperwork with a deadline.
Panel 2 – Form, Case 4802: Request: bus to wait. Duration: 2 seconds.
Panel 3 – Caption: 8:14 PM. Elsewhere. A commuter runs toward a bus.
note: Some favors are measured in seconds. I like the ones that ask for nothing else.
